Evidence:
[1] The Lad and the Lion is an adventure novel by Edgar Rice Burroughs, written in February 1914.
[2] Edgar Rice Burroughs (September 1, 1875 – March 19, 1950) was an American fiction writer best known for his celebrated and prolific output in the adventure and science-fiction genres.
[3] Robert Upshur "Bob" Woodward (born March 26, 1943) is an American investigative journalist and non-fiction author.
